name: manymotions-anime-story-video
description: Turn a story idea into an animated short in anime, cartoon, chibi, storybook or 3D style, with recurring characters, dialogue and narration, produced in your ManyMotions account.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a story idea into a short animated video in anime, flat cel, chibi, cartoon, storybook or 3D animation style.

Describe the story, the main characters, the art style and the mood, plus the spoken language, format and length. The plugin prepares a brief and shows the number of scenes and the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes the script scene by scene, keeps the characters and the art style consistent across scenes, generates the keyframes and the scene videos with AI voice, and edits the final cut. A video takes several minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the link to the MP4.

For storytellers, parents, teachers and creators of short-form videos.

Limitations: original stories from text only, meant for your own characters rather than existing franchises. It does not animate uploaded drawings or photos or edit footage. Producing a video uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a brief does not need an account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same brief opens on ManyMotions.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
capabilities: Track progress and return the MP4
defaultPrompt: An anime short about a paper crane that searches for the girl who folded it, 30 seconds
A chibi cartoon where two cats argue over the last sunny spot on the windowsill
A storybook tale of a lighthouse that learns to sing, narrated in Spanish

positive.prompt: Make an anime short about a paper crane that wakes up in a library and searches for the girl who folded it, heartwarming, 30 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief in anime style: 30 seconds, 5 scenes and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Pick an art style and format
positive.prompt: A chibi cartoon where two cats argue over the last sunny spot on the windowsill, funny, 15 seconds, vertical.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with art style chibi, format 9:16, 15 seconds (3 scenes) and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Produce a video and return it
positive.prompt: An 8-second cartoon of a snail that wins a race against a rabbit. Yes, generate it now and send me the video link when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The brief is prepared (2 scenes, 500 credits). After the go-ahead (if ChatGPT asks to confirm first, reply "Generate it"), generate_video starts the production in the signed-in account (state processing, credits used shown). get_video reports the current step; asked again once the production has completed (usually 5 to 10 minutes), it returns the absolute MP4 link and the ManyMotions link to open it.

positive.prompt: A 3D animation short about a small robot who learns to bake bread, cozy mood, 60 seconds, 16:9.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with art style 3d-animation, format 16:9, length 60 seconds (8 scenes) and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A storybook-style tale of a lighthouse that learns to sing, bittersweet, narrated in Spanish.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with art style storybook, language Spanish and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Animate this drawing my daughter made and turn it into a cartoon.
Recommend five classic anime series to watch this weekend.
Write me an essay about the history of Japanese animation.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing a video uses credits of the user's existing ManyMotions account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission with no functional changes: prepare a brief, produce the video in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the MP4.
